name: Florian Wirtz

career_stints.note: All-competitions career totals. Bundesliga-only split: 140 apps, 35 goals, 45 assists. No reliable finer positional-minutes breakdown (AM/LW/ST) was verifiable, so a single AM entry is used -- he is squad-listed as LW/AM/ST.
All-competitions season total (per Bundesliga.com retrospective). Premier League-only split: 33 apps, 5 goals, 3 assists, 2389 minutes.

notes: touches_per90 and duels_won_pct are from theanalyst.com (Opta-sourced), specifically his 'last 12 games' 2025/26 form split rather than a first-20-games split (63.9 touches/90, 36.2% duels) -- chosen as the more current/representative form, since the article frames his season as a slow start followed by improvement. For comparison, his final Leverkusen season averaged 83.6 touches/90 and ~43.3% combined duel success.

shots_per90, xg_per90, pass_accuracy_pct, and progressive_passes_per90 could not be verified from an accessible source (FBref/FotMob detail pages blocked or client-rendered) -- left null rather than guessed.
